remarks: Recently renovated amazing flat in a much sought after complex; This open concept plan features a gorgeous renovated kitchen with butcher block counter top. This 2 bedrooms (and extra office, entertainment room) and 2 full bath unit is very unique and is the only one designed like this in the complex. It has an attached 1 car garage and has a finished basement that includes a second large area for storage. The main level of living has sliders that open to a large deck that is very private. The main area has a large living room and dining room. The master bedroom is extremely large that boasts of 3 closets, 2 of them are walk-in's. The master also has it''s own en-suite. The spare bedroom is spacious with 2 closets (1 being a walk-in). The complex also has a large pool that is just around the corner from this unit. This condo is move-in ready and is just waiting for you to have it as your HOME.
